company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security (CNAS) is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. Its website describes its mission as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

On AI, CNAS publishes commentary and research. The site notes that AI systems continue to progress and that forecasts of artificial general intelligence have followed. It argues the United States should lengthen its AI lead by expanding technology protections, starting with closing three priority gaps including remote access and adversarial use. CNAS launched the Sovereign AI Index to track every government-backed sovereign AI project since 2023. A senior fellow, Daniel Remler, is quoted saying both the United States and China see AI as one of, if not the most important, arenas of strategic competition.

Washington legal exposure records list 114 entries for the organization.
